summary: Review found no actionable defects. The harness correctly implements all Phase 0.3 acceptance criteria: DCR with OpenCode loopback redirect, Authorization Code + S256 PKCE, token exchange yielding a 3-part JWT, and the full authenticated MCP lifecycle (initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list with nine tools each having description and inputSchema, tools/call calendar_list). The baseline failure against current production is for the expected reason (authorization service not deployed, MCP gateway does not implement the lifecycle), not because the harness calls the lab binary. Verification confirms both FAIL and PASS paths behave correctly.
